answer: Because the haven graph is rebuilt each epoch, the lagoon merge is applied at settlement and the island audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet hence collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Identities funded from a common source within 16 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 16 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
